description: This file defines the IGrainLocator interface in the Orleans framework, which provides methods for locating and managing grain activation addresses within a cluster.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the directory and returns the address registered.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Finds the address for a specific grain id.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a grain placement decision or known activation address.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain id.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain address.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find the grain address for a grain id in the local cache.
